jobs.title: Environmental Engineering / Hydrogeology Specialist
jobs.description:
Vacancy Number: 29258

Category: Engineering - Planning / Environmental

Job Type: Full-time

The Generation Engineering (GE) Planning & Environmental (P&E) Group is seeking a senior environmental engineer / contaminated land specialist to join the Environmental Engineering Team. The primary responsibility of the role will be managing and delivering services and solutions related to land remediation, pollution control and waste management across the Generation and Trading (GT) project portfolio. The successful candidate will act as a subject matter expert in land remediation and hydrogeology, leading environmental site investigations, risk assessments and remediation programmes, while ensuring compliance with environmental legislation, regulatory requirements and industry best practice.

Through specialist expertise in contaminated land, groundwater protection, environmental risk assessment and remediation, the successful candidate will help deliver resilient low-carbon infrastructure while protecting the environment, managing risk and supporting ESB's commitment to environmental excellence and sustainability.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage environmental site investigations, assessments and hydrogeological studies for development, operational and demolition/decommissioning projects.

* Procure and manage external consultants and contractors, review technical reports, and provide expert recommendations to project teams and senior management in relation to Conceptual Site Models (CSMs), Generic Quantitative Risk Assessments (GQRA), Detailed Quantitative Risk Assessments (DQRA) and Remedial Options Appraisals.Manage existing and/or new contract frameworks with relevant industry specialist contractors.

* Assess groundwater quality data and identify potential impacts to controlled waters, water supplies, ecosystems and sensitive receptors.

* Provide specialist advice on contaminated land management, land remediation, resource and waste management, and regulatory compliance.

* Manage environmental incident investigations involving land, groundwater or surface water contamination events.

* Undertake environmental compliance activities, including construction site environmental compliance and resource and waste management audits, for ESB construction projects.

* Contribute to the continual improvement of environmental management systems, technical standards and guidance documents.

**Experience and Qualifications**

**Essential**

* A minimum of 7 years of relevant experience within the area of environmental management / environmental compliance / programme management or equivalent

* Level 8 Environmental Engineering/Science Degree or equivalent qualification

* Demonstrated experience in contaminated land with exposure to a wide range of environmental and engineering situations including:

* Knowledge of and successful delivery of projects in accordance with the following: EPA Guidance on Contaminated Land and Groundwater at EPA licenced sites, 2013 & Environment Agency Land Contamination and Risk Management (LCRM) 2020; Guidance on the classification and assessment of waste (1st edition v1.1, WM3) & BS 10175:2011 + A2:2017 Investigation of potentially contaminated sites.

* Knowledge of and experience in soil and waste management, waste classification, hydrogeological assessment, due diligence, Licensing and Permitting, Generic Quantitative Risk Assessments (GQRA’s), Detailed Quantitative Risk Assessments (DQRA’s) and Remedial Options Appraisals.

* Working knowledge of Irish and EU environmental legislation and industry best practice standards /guidelines required.

* Experience with working in multi-disciplinary teams and delivering small to large scale projects.

* Strong project management skills, including excellent communication, collaboration and report writing skills.

* Full driving licence and access to a car.

**Desirable**

* Project management qualification

* Level 9 Environmental Engineering/Science Degree or equivalent qualification

* Chartership within a relevant professional institution / body.

**Location**

The successful candidates may be based in either:

* E&MP Offices, The Sidings Building, Dublin 2
* E&MP Offices, Eastgate, Little Island, Cork

Travel to project locations as required, is a key requirement of the role.

Smart Working at ESB is designed to make ‘in-person’ time together as purposeful as possible while also enabling the effective use of digital tools and hybrid arrangements to preserve our commitment to flexibility. The successful candidate may work flexibly within the jurisdiction where they have been employed, with attendance at the workplace for in-person collaboration at least two days per week. All Smart Working arrangements are subject to regular review based on the operational requirements of the role, the team, and the business.

**Reporting To**

Environmental Engineering Senior Team Lead in the Gen Eng Planning & Environmental Group.

  

**Why Work with Us?**

* Opportunity to lead Ireland's transition to a net-zero carbon future
* Career development through mentoring and training
* Corporate Social Responsibility opportunities
* Sports and Social Clubs
* Networking opportunities
* Credit Union
* Generous Pension
* Access to staff wellbeing programmes
* Generous parental leave entitlements

* Strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion
* Great team environment working to our Core Values: Courageous, Caring, Driven and Trusted
  

**Salary**

€59,000 - €70,000 per annum

  

**Closing Date**

21st October 2026

  

**Interview**

Candidates who are shortlisted for interview will complete a Behavioural Interview based on each of the following Behaviours, which underpin how we work at ESB and are critical to delivering our strategy:

* Accountable and Ethical

More information available on Our People Promise

  

**Notes**

The successful candidate will be required to evidence their right to work in the Republic of Ireland / UK prior to commencement of employment.

jobs.title: Onshore Cable Specialist Engineer
jobs.description:
Vacancy Number: 29257

Category: Engineering - Civil / Structural

Job Type: Full-time

The Generation Engineering Delivery department in ESB Engineering and Major Projects leads engineering support for ESB’s generation business. The Generation Cables department is responsible for the design and project management of high voltage underground grid cable connections for large scale thermal and renewable generation projects including offshore wind projects

This role will act as the lead engineering authority for the onshore underground section of the export cable system connecting major ESB and JV offshore wind farms in Ireland and the UK to the onshore grid. Active projects include Oriel and Five Estuaries. This role covers the full lifecycle of the onshore cable route - from early design and consenting through construction, commissioning, and handover into operations. You will ensure that all underground high‑voltage (HV) cable engineering activities meet project requirements, industry standards, and regulatory obligations while optimising safety, reliability, constructability, and long‑term asset performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Leadership: Lead the design, specification, and engineering assurance of the underground HV export cable system including cable selection, thermal rating, jointing, terminations, and civil works interfaces.

* Route Engineering & Civil Interface: Oversee development of the onshore cable route, including trench design, ducting, crossings, HDD sections, landfall interfaces, and coordination with civil engineering teams.

* Standards & Compliance: Ensure all engineering deliverables comply with relevant standards (e.g. IEC, CIGRE) and statutory requirements. Provide expert guidance on all aspects of cable system design, rating, earthing and bonding.

* Supplier & Contractor Management: Lead technical engagement with cable manufacturers, installation contractors, and specialist consultants. Review and approve technical documentation, method statements, FAT/SAT procedures, and installation quality plans.

* Construction & Installation Support: Provide senior engineering oversight during trenching, duct installation, cable pulling, jointing, testing, and commissioning. Resolve technical issues on site and ensure adherence to safety and quality standards.

* Risk & Interface Management: Identify and manage technical risks across interfaces with offshore cable systems, substations, grid connection points, and civil works. Ensure seamless integration of the onshore section with the overall export system.

* Asset Performance & Lifecycle Considerations: Contribute to long‑term reliability planning, including thermal performance modelling, failure mode analysis, maintenance strategies, and operational constraints.

* Safety to have highest priority in all aspects of work.

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**

**Essential**

* Extensive experience (typically 7+ years) in HV underground cable engineering for transmission or large‑scale renewable projects.

* Strong understanding of cable system design, installation techniques, thermal modelling, interface management, HV testing and commissioning.

* A good knowledge of standards applicable to HV Cables (e.g. IEC, CIGRE)

* Ability to work on own initiative, meet deadlines and manage multiple priorities.

* A flexible approach to work and strong ability to prioritise work.

* Good interpersonal, problem solving, communication and technical report writing skills.

* A strong work ethic with a clear focus on delivery to ESB’s’ Net Zero by 2040 Strategy’

* Strong commercial, project management and design review capability.

* Hold a full driving licence and have own car.

**Desirable**

* Chartered Engineer Status

**Qualifications**

**Essential**

Degree in Electrical Engineering or related discipline.

**Desirable**

Active involvement in international engineering organisations such as CIGRE, IEEE and IET (e.g. participation in Working Groups)

**Location**

The position will be based in ESB Engineering & Major Projects’ offices at The Sidings, Grand Canal Quay, Dublin 2, D02 E7K8.

Smart Working at ESB is designed to make ‘in-person’ time together as purposeful as possible while also enabling the effective use of digital tools and hybrid arrangements to preserve our commitment to flexibility. The successful candidate may work flexibly within the jurisdiction where they have been employed, with attendance at the workplace for in-person collaboration at least two days per week. All Smart Working arrangements are subject to regular review based on the operational requirements of the role, the team, and the business.

**Reporting to**

Generation Cables Group Team Lead in Generation Engineering Delivery and the Project Package Manager.

jobs.title: Integration & HyperAutomation Engineer
jobs.description:
Clorox is the place that’s committed to growth – for our people and our brands. Guided by our purpose and values, and with people at the center of everything we do, we believe every one of us can make a positive impact on consumers, communities, and teammates. Join our team. #CloroxIsThePlace

**Your role at Clorox:**

The Integration & HyperAutomation Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and supporting enterprise integrations and intelligent automations that enable business process transformation, operational efficiency, and digital innovation. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with expertise in APIs, integrations, robotic process automation (RPA), workflow automation, and AI-enabled automation capabilities. The engineer partners closely with Solution Architects, Product Owners, Technical Leads, Business Analysts, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, and business stakeholders to implement secure, reliable, and reusable solutions that connect applications, data, and business processes across the enterprise.

**In this role, you will:**

This role sits at the centre of Clorox's digital transformation agenda. The Integration & HyperAutomation Engineer helps the business operate faster, smarter, and more efficiently by connecting enterprise systems and automating complex business processes. Through enterprise integrations, APIs, robotic process automation (RPA), and AI-enabled solutions, this position directly contributes to productivity improvements, scalability, and innovation across the organisation.

The successful candidate will design, build, and support enterprise integrations using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform and intelligent automations using UiPath. They will work with business and technology teams to create secure, scalable solutions that connect applications, data, and workflows across functions such as Finance, HR, Sales, Marketing, and Operations.

Key areas of focus include:

* Building and managing APIs and enterprise integrations
* Developing intelligent automation and RPA solutions
* Leveraging AI services to enhance business processes
* Supporting enterprise-wide digital transformation initiatives
* Creating reusable assets and frameworks that accelerate future delivery

Key selling points:

* Opportunity to work on high-impact enterprise transformation initiatives
* Exposure to cutting-edge technologies including Generative AI, Agentic AI, intelligent automation, and API-led architectures
* Ability to influence how business processes are modernised across a global organisation
* Strong cross-functional visibility, partnering with architects, product teams, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and business leaders
* Excellent platform for career growth in integration engineering, automation, and AI-driven technology solutions
* Opportunity to gain or utilise highly sought-after certifications in MuleSoft and UiPath

This role is a key enabler of Clorox's digital transformation strategy, helping the company become more connected, automated, and AI-enabled. By building enterprise integrations and intelligent automations, the engineer reduces manual effort, improves data flow across systems, accelerates business processes, and enables teams to focus on higher-value work.

The successful hire will:

* **Drive operational efficiency** by automating repetitive processes and eliminating manual handoffs.
* **Accelerate business transformation** through API-led connectivity and intelligent workflow orchestration.
* **Improve business agility** by enabling faster integration of new applications, platforms, and technologies.
* **Enhance employee productivity** through automation and AI-powered solutions.
* **Strengthen enterprise scalability** by creating reusable integration and automation assets that can be leveraged across multiple business functions.
* **Support AI adoption** by connecting enterprise systems and data that serve as the foundation for future AI and agentic capabilities.
* **Reduce risk and improve reliability** through secure, governed, and resilient integration architecture.

**What we look for:**

This role would suit an engineer with:

* 3-5+ years of software development, integration, or automation experience
* Hands-on expertise with MuleSoft and/or UiPath
* Strong API development and integration experience
* Experience with cloud and enterprise platforms such as SAP, ServiceNow, Workday, Azure, or Power Platform
* Programming skills in Java, C#, Python, or similar technologies
* A passion for automation, AI, and continuous improvement

**Workplace type:**

#LI-ybrid

**Our values-based culture connects to our purpose and empowers people to be their best, professionally and personally. We serve a diverse consumer base which is why we believe teams that reflect our consumers bring fresh perspectives, drive innovation, and help us stay attuned to the world around us. That’s why we foster an inclusive culture where every person can feel respected, valued, and fully able to participate, and ultimately able to thrive.** **Learn more****.**

**Benefits we offer to help you be well and thrive:**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Competitive compensation
* Generous 401(k) program in the US and similar programs in international
* Health benefits and programs that support both your physical and mental well-being
* Flexible work environment, depending on your role
* Meaningful opportunities to keep learning and growing

Category: Engineering - Civil / Structural

Job Type: Full-time

The Generation Engineering Civil and Environment Group within Engineering & Major Projects provides the full range of planning, design, construction, operation & maintenance and management services required for electricity industry infrastructure projects in Ireland and overseas.

A vacancy now exists for a Civil Engineer to work on projects as part of multidisciplinary engineering project teams. The successful candidate will be involved in the delivery of civil engineering services from feasibility through construction stage across a wide range electricity infrastructure projects for ESB. The portfolio of work will include new build projects, remedial works to existing assets and the development of new energy projects in Ireland and abroad. The portfolio will encompass buildings, power stations, electrical infrastructure, and large macro-infrastructure such as dams. This is an exciting opportunity to work in the delivery of many interesting civil and structural projects which ESB have in the delivery of its program to transition to Net Zero Carbon by 2040.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provision of civil, drainage, hydraulic and hydrological technical engineering services in the delivery of project works packages.

* Designing surface water drainage systems for developments in urban and rural settings including the appropriate use of sustainable drainage systems (SUDS).

* Carrying out Flood Risk Assessment and hydrological studies (e.g. Section 50 Applications).

* Demonstrate a commitment to safety and quality in all aspects of your role.
